intro: We do not publish a price per roof, because a price per roof would be a guess. What we can do is tell you exactly what moves the number: how many roofing squares you have (a square is 100 square feet of roof), the pitch, the condition of the decking under the old shingles, the material you choose, and whether the work runs through insurance or retail. Get a free inspection and you get a written estimate broken out by line — tear-off, underlayment, ventilation, disposal — so you can compare our bid against anyone else's honestly. If the roof still has years left in it, we will tell you that instead of selling you one.
notes: 0% financing is available on qualifying roofing, siding, gutter and deck projects, with short-term and long-term plans at competitive APRs. Military, first responders and seniors receive 5% off any full roof or gutter installation or repair over $1,500.
